notes.title: New Exotic Waifu: Rania, the Servant
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/70fb055b873d8bd690e5385c7e5860b2282349a3.png[/img]

This shy lady from far away is bound to SERVE the Autocracy's will. Something about your gaze sparks her soul with forbidden passions - but she will need to follow protocol, if only for the moment.

[h2](SERVE is also a code you can redeem in the game for extra crystals) [/h2]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE + BUG FIX
notes.content:
[p]There was a pretty nasty bug the past few days that affected quite a few games, and we now have  a fix live. If you've been experiencing an invisible shop, infinite currencies that you cannot use, and menus that aren't interactable, please update your game and put these troubles behind you. 😊[/p][p][/p][p]The new update also comes with [i]some nifty features.[/i][/p][list][*][p]Waifu Shop now has a [b]Shard Exchange Shop[/b]! Check under your Shop menu to turn in your dupes for new rewards - including Shard Dust exclusive new character, Celia![/p][/*][*][p]All [b]duplicate shards[/b] will now be automatically turned to [b]Shard Dust[/b].,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Check your craftable items again! The recipes now have [i]lore[/i].,[/p][/*][*][p]As mentioned above - [b]Invisible Shops invisible no more[/b]! If your game has been buggy recently, it'll work fine again when you next launch it.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]If you are having trouble updating (though the game should auto-update as soon as you start it), try this:
Right-click on Waifu Shop in your Steam Library menu > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files. That'll sort you out for sure![/p]

tags.bug: - Invisible Shops invisible no more! If your game has been buggy recently, it'll work fine again when you next launch it.

tags.feature: - Waifu Shop now has a Shard Exchange Shop! Check under your Shop menu to turn in your dupes for new rewards - including Shard Dust exclusive new character, Celia!
- All duplicate shards will now be automatically turned to Shard Dust.
- Check your craftable items again! The recipes now have lore.

notes.title: New Exotic Waifu: Yukio, the Ninja - June 2nd - 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45549806/67268495a368be86b2e74939d89af339c52297e2.png[/img]

You'll never see her coming, her footsteps are lighter than the softest of breaths... unless she breaks something in your Shop. Uhhh whoops, this shuriken is, like, really heavy. 😢 We have a STEALTHY new Exotic Waifu - catch her if you can!

[h3](STEALTHY is also a code you can redeem in the game for extra crystals)[/h3]
